binaries.note: with HS_RUSTC unset, rustc is the rustup proxy and sysroot the toolchain selected by rust-toolchain.toml

build.jobs: cargo default (-j not passed, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS as recorded) = nproc
build.cold_definition: CARGO_TARGET_DIR removed before every cold attempt; ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git kept warm

registry_cache.how: cargo fetch --locked ran once in setup before any sample

protocol.foreign_definition: cargo processes, or rustc / clippy-driver / rustdoc processes with --crate-name (an actual compile), outside this runner process tree and whose command line does not mention the benchmark work dir
protocol.contaminated_definition: any of: a foreign process at sample start, at any monitor tick or in the end-of-sample snapshot; the load wait hit its cap; the quiet-flag wait hit its cap (see contamination_reasons)

quiet_flag.how: before each sample, wait while `quietlock check` reports the host quiet flag held by another job, at most wait_cap_s; a capped wait is logged and marks the sample contaminated; per-sample quiet_flag_checked / quiet_flag_wait_s / quiet_flag_wait_capped

ab.order: per round: check X, build Y, test-no-run X, A/A first, check Y, build X, test-no-run Y, A/A second; round 1 X=OFF Y=ON first=A, swapped every round; job-count builds after the main rounds, OFF/ON order swapped every round
ab.target_dirs: each arm has its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR (<target>-<arm>), removed before every cold attempt

quiet_hold.how: with enabled, each sample runs: the quiet_flag queue wait, then `quietlock hold --owner <owner> --minutes <minutes> --reason <reason>` around the load wait and the timed command, released before the next sample; a refused hold queues again (within wait_cap_s); a hold not taken marks the sample contaminated (quiet_hold_not_taken). Per-sample quiet_hold {requested, held, id, acquire_s, refused}; samples_held / samples_unheld list sample ids

ab_incremental.order: prime OFF then ON (each on its own fresh target dir), 3 no-op checks per arm, then body and iface series as in incr; after every edit both arms check the same source, OFF first on odd steps and ON first on even steps; settle check per arm after every revert
ab_incremental.reason: same edit targets as the M0 stable baseline (baseline-20261015-4c83e38 manifest.incremental.reason), so the incremental series are comparable
ab_incremental.failure_rule: a failed ON (or OFF) check is recorded with its exit status and log tail and the series continues; it is never counted as a time
